name: Neal Signature Homes — Vicenzo
heroHeadline: What if clients arrived at the Design Gallery prepared?
heroBody: Your Vicenzo kitchen at Aria with real upgrade selections wired up. Clients pick finishes and see them in the room.
photoBaseline: Kitchen in the Vicenzo model at Aria viewed from one end of the island looking along its length toward the perimeter wall. All white shaker-style cabinets with gold/brass bar pulls on both perimeter walls and the island. White marble-look quartz countertops with gray veining on all surfaces including the island. White vertical kit kat/finger tile backsplash running the full width of the perimeter wall between the countertop and upper cabinets — narrow rectangular tiles stacked vertically with subtle texture. Gas cooktop on the island surface with a stainless steel rectangular range hood suspended above. Stainless steel built-in wall oven and microwave stack to the right of the range hood area. Stainless steel French door refrigerator further right. Tall white pantry cabinets flanking the fridge. Gold/brass gooseneck faucet on the island countertop on the right side. Warm natural wood-look LVP plank flooring throughout. White/cream painted walls. Flat ceiling with recessed can lights. Doorway visible on the right side leading to other rooms.
spatialHint: Camera at one end of the island looking along its length toward the perimeter wall. Left foreground: island side with white shaker cabinets, gold hardware, gas cooktop on the island surface. Center/back wall: stainless rectangular range hood above, white shaker upper and lower perimeter cabinets. BACKSPLASH: white vertical kit kat/finger tiles running the full width of the perimeter wall between the countertop and upper cabinets — narrow rectangular tiles oriented vertically. Right of center: stainless wall oven + microwave stack, then stainless French door refrigerator, tall white pantry cabinets. Right side of island: gold gooseneck faucet, marble-look quartz countertop. Warm wood-look LVP flooring across entire floor. White/cream walls. Flat ceiling with recessed lights. Doorway on right leading to other rooms.
